description: Principles, types, and applications of robotics and industrial automation

entries.definition: Robotics combines mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and computer science to design and build programmable machines that can perform tasks automatically.

robot_components.actuators: Convert electrical signals into physical motion (motors, hydraulics, pneumatics)
robot_components.sensors: Detect environment (cameras, LIDAR, force sensors, encoders, IMUs)
robot_components.controller: Central processing unit managing robot operations
robot_components.end_effector: The 'hand' of a robot; grippers, welding torches, suction cups
robot_components.power_supply: Batteries, AC power, or pneumatic/hydraulic lines

robot_types.industrial: Fixed arm robots for manufacturing (KUKA, Fanuc, ABB)
robot_types.collaborative: Cobots designed to work safely alongside humans (Universal Robots UR series)

mobile.ground: Wheeled or legged; autonomous vehicles, warehouse robots

robot_types.humanoid: Bipedal human-form robots (Boston Dynamics Atlas, Tesla Optimus)
robot_types.surgical: Precision medical robots (da Vinci Surgical System)

degrees_of_freedom.definition: Number of independent movements a robot can make
degrees_of_freedom.more_dof: Greater flexibility but more complex control

kinematics.forward: Given joint angles, calculate end-effector position
kinematics.inverse: Given desired position, calculate required joint angles
kinematics.workspace: Volume of space the end-effector can reach

control_systems.localization: Determine robot's position in environment (SLAM: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping)
control_systems.ros: Robot Operating System; open-source framework for robot software development

perception.computer_vision: Cameras + algorithms to interpret visual information
perception.lidar: Light Detection and Ranging; 3D mapping using laser pulses
perception.point_cloud: 3D data from LIDAR or depth cameras
perception.object_detection: YOLO, R-CNN for identifying objects in real time

industrial_automation.plc: Programmable Logic Controller; industrial computer for process automation
industrial_automation.scada: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition; monitor and control industrial systems
industrial_automation.industry_4_0: Fourth industrial revolution; IoT, AI, cyber-physical systems in manufacturing

applications.logistics: Warehouse automation (Amazon Kiva robots), autonomous forklifts
applications.agriculture: Autonomous harvesting, precision spraying, soil sensing
applications.exploration: Mars rovers (Curiosity, Perseverance), deep sea exploration

future_trends.soft_robotics: Flexible, compliant robots safe for human interaction
future_trends.swarm_robotics: Many simple robots coordinating to perform complex tasks
future_trends.autonomous_vehicles: Self-driving cars using cameras, LIDAR, radar, AI
future_trends.ai_integration: Deep learning for perception, planning, and adaptive behavior
future_trends.human_robot_collaboration: Safe integration of robots in shared workspaces
